observations: Compact cephalon with swollen central glabella, small eyes, overlapping arched segments, long lateral spines and two open backward horn loops. Dark blue-slate primary material, warm gray rims. Hero and top have two horns; side merges the pair. Fine segment/side-spine counts differ across panels.
cross_view_resolution: Use ten authored thoracic plates, paired genal spines and ten paired swept pleural tips, plus two occipital horns with open air gaps. Counts are deliberate artistic simplification, not taxonomic claims. No eye stalks. Underside is a closed quiet ventral volume without invented fine appendage anatomy.
